title: General English — GCE Advanced Level Mock Paper
instructions: Answer all questions on this paper itself.
Marks will be deducted for bad punctuation (Omission of full stops, capital letters, etc.) and for mistakes in basic grammar.
The supervisor will provide you with sheets for rough work.
Use additional reading time to go through the question paper and decide on the questions that you give priority in answering.

sections.title: PART A - READING SKILLS
sections.instructions: Read the following texts and poems carefully and answer the questions that follow, using the provided information and inferring where necessary.

questions.prompt: Read the following text in which some words are given in bold type. Then, underline the meaning that is most appropriate to the context for the words given in bold type from (1) - (10).

sub_parts.prompt: The rapid **depletion** of natural resources is a major global concern. (exhaustion/ increase/ protection/ discovery)
Governments are urged to **implement** stricter regulations. (propose/ enforce/ discuss/ delay)
This will help to **mitigate** the adverse effects of climate change. (intensify/ worsen/ lessen/ ignore)
Community engagement is **crucial** for successful conservation projects. (unimportant/ vital/ optional/ peripheral)
Educating the public can foster a greater **appreciation** for biodiversity. (disregard/ understanding/ criticism/ destruction)
Many species face the risk of **extinction** due to habitat loss. (survival/ proliferation/ disappearance/ adaptation)
Sustainable practices are **imperative** for future generations. (unnecessary/ optional/ essential/ debatable)
The **advocacy** of environmental groups plays a key role. (opposition/ support/ silence/ denial)
This issue requires a **concerted** effort from all stakeholders. (fragmented/ individual/ combined/ minor)
Long-term planning is **indispensable** for achieving ecological balance. (dispensable/ vital/ optional/ superfluous)

questions.context_passage: The rapid **depletion** of natural resources is a major global concern, prompting urgent calls for action. Governments are urged to **implement** stricter regulations to protect fragile ecosystems. This will help to **mitigate** the adverse effects of climate change and preserve natural habitats. Community engagement is **crucial** for successful conservation projects, fostering local ownership and participation. Educating the public can foster a greater **appreciation** for biodiversity and the delicate balance of nature. Unfortunately, many species face the risk of **extinction** due to habitat loss and pollution. Sustainable practices are **imperative** for future generations to ensure resource availability. The **advocacy** of environmental groups plays a key role in raising awareness and pressuring policy-makers. Addressing this complex issue requires a **concerted** effort from all stakeholders, including individuals, industries, and governments. Long-term planning is **indispensable** for achieving ecological balance and a healthy planet.

questions.prompt: Read the following text and answer the questions (I) and (II). Do the following statements agree with the information given in the above text? In boxes (1) - (10), write True, False or Not Given.

sub_parts.prompt: Regular exercise improves both physical and mental well-being.
A balanced diet consists primarily of carbohydrates.
Lack of sleep can impair cognitive functions and mood.
Mindfulness meditation is only effective for reducing stress in adults.
Social interaction has no impact on mental health.
Exposure to nature has been linked to lower stress levels.
Setting realistic goals can boost self-esteem and motivation.
Consuming excessive amounts of sugar is beneficial for brain health.
Chronic stress does not affect the immune system.
Engaging in hobbies can provide a sense of purpose and joy.

questions.context_passage:
Maintaining optimal mental and physical health requires a holistic approach, incorporating various lifestyle factors. Regular physical activity, such as brisk walking or cycling, has been consistently linked to improved mood, reduced anxiety, and enhanced cognitive function. Alongside exercise, a balanced diet rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains provides essential nutrients for brain health and overall vitality. Adequate sleep, typically 7-9 hours per night for adults, is fundamental for memory consolidation, emotional regulation, and physical restoration. Lack of sufficient sleep can impair concentration and increase irritability.

Furthermore, cultivating strong social connections is crucial for emotional well-being. Engaging with friends, family, and community groups can provide a sense of belonging and support, acting as a buffer against stress. Practicing mindfulness and meditation techniques can also significantly reduce stress and improve emotional resilience. Exposure to nature, even for short periods, has demonstrated positive effects on mental clarity and reduced feelings of fatigue. Finally, pursuing hobbies and engaging in creative activities offers a sense of purpose and accomplishment, contributing to a fulfilling life.

questions.prompt: Read the following passage and underline the most appropriate response to each of the questions from (1) - (5).

sub_parts.prompt: What is the primary objective of the Mars Perseverance rover?
Which instrument on Perseverance is designed to produce oxygen?
How does Ingenuity assist the rover's mission?
What kind of geological feature is the Jezero Crater?
The passage suggests that the Perseverance mission is primarily focused on:

questions.context_passage:
NASA's Mars Perseverance rover, which landed in the Jezero Crater in February 2021, continues its ambitious mission to seek signs of ancient microbial life. The rover, a six-wheeled mobile laboratory, is equipped with a sophisticated suite of instruments to analyze Martian geology and collect rock and soil samples for eventual return to Earth. One of its key tools is MOXIE (Mars Oxygen In-Situ Resource Utilization Experiment), which successfully demonstrated the ability to produce oxygen from the Martian atmosphere, a crucial step for future human exploration.

Accompanying Perseverance is the Ingenuity Mars Helicopter, a small robotic rotorcraft that has performed numerous successful flights, serving as a scout to help the rover navigate difficult terrain and identify potential scientific targets. The Jezero Crater itself is of significant scientific interest, believed to have once been a lakebed and river delta, offering prime locations for finding preserved biosignatures. The data collected by Perseverance will significantly enhance our understanding of Mars' past habitability and pave the way for future human missions.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blanks using one word from the passage in each space.

sub_parts.prompt: Effective teamwork begins with clear (1) ___________ among team members.
Each individual's (2) ___________ contributes to the overall success of a project.
When team members actively (3) ___________ to each other, misunderstandings are minimized.
Trust is a fundamental (4) ___________ that fosters an environment of openness.
Shared (5) ___________ ensure that everyone is working towards the same objectives.
Resolving (6) ___________ constructively is vital for maintaining harmony.
Team leaders must (7) ___________ collaboration and provide necessary guidance.
Celebrating small (8) ___________ along the way motivates the team.
The diversity of skills and (9) ___________ within a team can lead to innovative solutions.
Ultimately, a strong team (10) ___________ enhances productivity and job satisfaction.

questions.context_passage: Effective teamwork begins with clear **communication** among team members. Each individual's **contribution** contributes to the overall success of a project. When team members actively **listen** to each other, misunderstandings are minimized. Trust is a fundamental **element** that fosters an environment of openness and mutual respect. Shared **goals** ensure that everyone is working towards the same objectives. Resolving **conflicts** constructively is vital for maintaining harmony and a positive working atmosphere. Team leaders must **encourage** collaboration and provide necessary guidance and resources. Celebrating small **achievements** along the way motivates the team and reinforces a sense of progress. The diversity of skills and **perspectives** within a team can lead to innovative solutions and greater creativity. Ultimately, a strong team **spirit** enhances productivity and job satisfaction, making complex tasks more manageable.

questions.context_passage:
Urban development in rapidly growing cities presents unique **challenges**. Many cities are grappling with issues of overcrowding, inadequate infrastructure, and environmental degradation. As populations expand, so does the demand for housing, transportation, and public services. Without proper planning, **they** risk chaotic expansion and a decline in living standards. The urban planning department has been tasked with creating a sustainable blueprint, but **its** efforts are often hampered by limited resources and bureaucratic hurdles.

One particularly **crucial** aspect is the management of waste, which has become an overwhelming problem. Recycling initiatives have been introduced, **which** aim to reduce landfill waste, but active participation from citizens is low. Authorities must find ways to engage **them** more effectively. Furthermore, preserving green spaces within city limits is also **essential** for public health and biodiversity. It is imperative to **enhance** these areas and **identify** new ones for development, ensuring a balance between modernity and nature for all **citizens**.

sections.title: PART C - WRITING SKILLS
sections.instructions: Demonstrate writing proficiency through various tasks including sentence construction, data description, and extended writing forms such as emails, letters, and essays.

questions.prompt:
Select any five words from the list of nouns, verbs, adjectives and adverbs given below and use each one of them in a meaningful sentence. You may use the verbs in any tense. Do not change the form of the other words.

Nouns: dedication, innovation
Verbs: analyze, facilitate, adapt
Adjectives: intricate, resilient
Adverbs: diligently, sparingly

The bar chart below shows the percentage of students participating in various extracurricular activities in a local school in 2023. Describe the information by reporting the main features and making comparisons where relevant. Use about 75 words.

Data for Bar Chart:
Activity | Percentage of Students
---|---
Sports Club | 60%
Debate Society | 35%
Art & Craft | 45%
Environmental Club | 20%

Imagine that you have successfully completed a challenging project at work, and you want to share your experience with a former mentor. Write an email to your mentor describing your achievement and how their guidance helped you. In your email, include the following: a brief overview of the project; the challenges you faced; how your mentor's advice was crucial; and an expression of gratitude. You may include any relevant details but do not exceed 75 words.

You see an advertisement in a local newspaper for the post of Junior Marketing Executive. Qualifications required: a degree or diploma in Marketing; excellent communication skills; proficiency in digital marketing tools; age limit: 22 - 30 years. Imagine that you have the required qualifications. Write a cover letter, applying for the post. Do NOT write a CV. Use about 75-100 words for the body of the letter. Do not exceed the word limit.

Some people believe that traditional libraries are becoming obsolete in the digital age. Others argue that they remain vital community hubs. What is your opinion? Write an essay, giving your views on this. Use about 150-200 words. Do not exceed the word limit.
